title: Parent Line, 09:33: Riverside Student Not on Any List

fields.systemName: Recorded Line - Parent & Family Line, transferred to EOC Room 108

callee.name: Dean of Students (Housing and Mass Care)
callee.label: Parent line, transferred to the EOC, Campus Services Building room 108

transcript.speaker: Parent line staffer
transcript.text: Dean, it's the parent line. I have a mother holding and she's very upset. Before I put her through, the Kessler registration desk is on the bridge with the 09:30 count. You'll want it first.

transcript.speaker: Kessler registration desk
transcript.text: Kessler desk, 09:30 count. Riverside roster, six hundred eighty. Registered here from Riverside, six hundred four. Signed out at the door to friends or family off campus, from the RA sheets, sixty-one. That leaves fifteen Riverside residents who aren't on any list. And three walk-ins say they live in Riverside, but they're not on the roster. One more thing. The EOC inbox forwarded us an email from the Ohio EMA watch desk, sent 09:32. For their preliminary flood damage report they want the number displaced from Riverside and from the Sugar Run Apartments, and how many are in the shelter, by 11:00. Are we sending them numbers, or are you?

transcript.speaker: Parent line staffer
transcript.text: Putting her through now. Her son lives on the fourth floor of Riverside.

transcript.speaker: Parent
transcript.text: Hello? Are you the person in charge? My kid LIVES in Riverside Hall. Fourth floor. I've texted six times and he doesn't answer. Your shelter people say he's not registered, and the housing office says he's not on the Riverside list. How can my child live there and not be on your list? Is he still in that building? I'm calling Channel 9 next. Tell me right now if my child is safe.

transcript.speaker: Parent
transcript.text: Don't tell me you're checking. His name is Mateo Castillo. He's a sophomore. He swapped rooms with a friend after winter break. I think the friend's on four, or maybe he's still in the old room. I don't know! That's your job. Did anybody actually knock on his door?

transcript.speaker: Parent
transcript.text: Fine. I'm sending you everything I have the minute I hang up, from parent.caller@familymail.example: his phone number, his schedule, the friend's name. If I don't hear back from a real person soon, Channel 9 hears from me. Write down my number, seven four oh, five five five, zero one eight seven.

voiceStyles.Parent line staffer: Woman in her 30s, calm, quick, slightly hoarse after an hour on the phones
voiceStyles.Kessler registration desk: Man in his 20s reading numbers off a clipboard, crowd noise and echo of a fieldhouse behind him
voiceStyles.Parent: Woman in her late 40s, frightened and angry, talking fast, voice breaking, interrupts if the answer is vague

instructorNote: This is a pressure inject. It tests whether DoS and CPD compare the roster, the RA floor sheets and Kessler registration, and treat the 15 unlisted residents and Mateo C. as unaccounted for rather than absent. Watch for CPD checking the sweep officers and the unofficial-occupant angle (room swap, guest). The PIO and DoS should answer the parent within MENSO 6: Riverside is being evacuated and students are sheltered at Kessler, but nothing about this student unless he consents or DoS and University Counsel decide the health and safety exception applies. The IC should send the Ohio EMA only reconciled numbers.
